design.title: Account availability and revocation design
design.summary: Extend the existing app/model/admin forms; use transactional session-identifier rotation and additive SQLite migration.
design.boundary: Isolated Flask-Admin teaching application source and ephemeral local SQLite only; no upstream or production writes.
design.target_state_summary: Enabled state is visible/editable, revoked sessions stay revoked, and persisted accounts survive restart/migration.
design.impact_summary: App/model/forms and isolated tests only; existing teaching authorization model retained.

changes.baseline_state: No persisted availability switch or suspended-account access guard.
changes.target_state: Working status edit/filter, immediate session revocation and additive migration.
Deterministic tests and minimal local delivery documentation.

decisions.question: How should disabling invalidate outstanding sessions without deleting accounts?
options: Rotate alternative login identity and reject disabled loads
decisions.decision: Rotate identity on disable and reject disabled accounts on every protected load.
decisions.rationale: Meets immediate revocation and prevents old-session resurrection while retaining existing accounts.

DOM-110.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Account state and current session transitions

Enabled is the default. Disabling rotates the alternative login identifier in the same update transaction. Re-enable does not revert that identifier. Logout removes the current session.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.verification_object: Account state and current session transitions
vfy_points.observable_result: Active login succeeds, disabled login is rejected and a retained old cookie stays rejected after re-enable.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-120.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Manager editing and sign-in interactions

Reuse Flask-Admin account list/edit/filter and the default form error interaction. Keep logout as an explicit POST form with CSRF. Authentication failures remain on the sign-in page without revealing credentials.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.observable_result: A manager can edit status, filter results, and receive non-success responses for invalid input without a hidden mutation.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

DOM-220.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### User model, login loader and model administration

Keep an app factory with SQLAlchemy and Flask-Login extension initialization. User.get_id returns the alternative identifier; the loader returns only enabled rows. Model-view access follows the existing enabled-authenticated-manager teaching boundary.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.verification_object: User model, login loader and model administration
vfy_points.observable_result: Model updates, login loading, and protected views agree on account availability.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-230.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Authentication and mutation endpoints

Reuse /admin/login/, /admin/register/, /admin/logout/ and account CRUD routes. Mutations are POST and CSRF protected; next accepts only local URLs. Read access alone never changes account state.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.observable_result: Anonymous/forged requests are denied, missing CSRF cannot mutate, and external next never navigates off-site.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-240.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Persisted enabled status and alternative identifier

Add Boolean enabled with non-null true default and rotate alternative_id only on a true-to-false transition. New credentials use salted password hashing. The per-app instance secret is supplied externally, never committed.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.verification_object: Persisted enabled status and alternative identifier
vfy_points.observable_result: Database flags match forms; password storage is not plaintext; disable transitions rotate identifiers once.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-310.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Authentication, session revocation and CSRF

Reject disabled accounts both during login validation and subsequent user loading. Protect auth and edit forms with Flask-WTF CSRF. Reject forged sessions and unsafe redirects. This synthetic-data example keeps its prior simple manager model; it is not a new production RBAC implementation.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.observable_result: Disabled and forged sessions fail, CSRF-invalid state changes fail, while legitimate manager workflows remain available.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-320.reason: No throughput/latency requirement or new workload; one indexed account load per protected request, no capacity certification.

DOM-330.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Restart and failed-request consistency

Commit account updates transactionally; failed validation/CSRF must leave state unchanged. Dispose test connections; initialize per-app extensions, not persistent module-global state.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.observable_result: Restart preserves state; rejected requests do not alter accounts; two clients cannot revive a revoked old cookie.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-340.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Existing SQLite account migration

Inspect existing user columns before adding enabled with DEFAULT 1. Preserve id, username and other account data. Repeating migration is a no-op. Never drop or re-seed the legacy table.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.observable_result: Two migration runs retain the original row identity and data; migrated accounts have an explicit enabled state.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-350.design_result_markdown:
## 设计结果 Design Result

### Maintainable reproducible regression

Place feature regression in a test module with isolated temporary databases and explicit client sessions. Preserve the upstream BSD license and source provenance. Keep dependencies fixed and application configuration injectable.

constraints_impacts.content: Preserve the existing teaching-project boundary and satisfy the requirement without production effects.

vfy_points.observable_result: The same test command exercises positive, rejection, restart and migration cases with isolated cleanup.
vfy_points.expected_evidence: Actual request assertions, database readback and execution output bound to the tested result.

evidence_references.purpose: Existing project provenance and isolated preparation

DOM-410.design_result_markdown:

### Local runtime and sandbox delivery

| ID | 类型 Type | Disposition | 方法明细 Method Detail | 适用范围 Scope | 方法 Method | 选择依据 Selection Basis | 承载位置 Host | Exception Reference |

### 可验证性设计 Verifiability Design

Inject app configuration and isolated SQLite; retain alternative identifier and load enabled accounts on every protected request. Host domains DOM-220, DOM-240 and DOM-350. No test-only success hook.

### 环境与数据 Environment and Data

Use prepared fixed Python dependencies, actual Flask WSGI request handling, temporary SQLite and synthetic credentials. Reset each test, close connections, disable network during formal methods. No external accounts or production data.

### 覆盖策略 Coverage Strategy

Cover normal login, disable/re-enable and another active manager; invalid credentials, CSRF and forged cookies; duplicate/blank registration; restart and repeated legacy migration. Exclude production performance and subjective aesthetics, which are not acceptance objectives.
